description: Phase 6. Healing introduces mid-epoch removals, un-deferring the q67.38 obligation: a displaced-but-alive materializer must learn in-band, not wait for the next recovery push. FDB shape (ApplyMetadataMutation privatization -> storageserver applyPrivateData worker_removed): the proxy's apply-then-route step dual-routes the materializers/<tag> change to the victim's own shard tag so the worker observes its own displacement in the stream it already follows and self-retires (dispose store, exit, foreman janitors). Do not build before phase 4 exists.
title: In-band retirement: the victim learns from its own stream
